game.title: New York Jets at Detroit Lions

lede: Detroit Lions carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#5 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Detroit Lions -15.1 with a fair total of 49.9, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Detroit Lions pass offence vs New York Jets pass defence, which sits +0.383 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

reads: The quarterback difference is worth +0.7 points of the projected spread — the engine’s own qb_adj_diff term, and the only place a quarterback moves this number.
Both starters are confirmed by the schedule feed, so the quarterback term is priced from the learned value of the two players actually named.
The learned QB layer is identity-keyed and value-only: it says how a quarterback has played, never how he is feeling, and it knows nothing about a start nobody has announced.
